create.name: Aja Daashuur
create.bio:
Aja Daashuur is a medium and spiritual teacher based in Los Angeles, where she started Spirit House Collective in 2017 as a community for metaphysical learning, with a particular commitment to making spiritual education welcoming for Black, Indigenous and other people of colour. She says she was sensitive to spirit from childhood. Her training includes past life regression with Dr. Brian Weiss, study of the Akashic Records with Helen Vonderheide, and trance mediumship courses at the Arthur Findlay College in England.

She works under the name The Spirit Guide Coach, pairing mediumship with life coaching. Her sessions follow her own four-step CCCE Method (Connect, Channel, Clear, Embody): making contact with a client's spirit guides, talking through the patterns that surface, clearing heavy energy and then agreeing practical steps and rituals. Sessions run on Zoom and open three times a year, and a three-month Seeker Program offers regular work across a season. She has created two oracle decks, including Spirit Guide Portal (Weiser Books, 2026), illustrated by Justin Daashuur Hopkins, and leads retreats at Esalen and elsewhere in California, as well as community gatherings such as Spirit Church.

books.title: Spirit Guide Portal: Your Oracle to Access Higher Wisdom
books.author: AJA Daashuur
books.description: An oracle deck of 40 gilt-edged cards with a 112-page colour guidebook, published by Weiser Books in 2026 and illustrated by Justin Daashuur Hopkins. Each card shows an archetype and speaks in three voices, 'I Am', 'I Offer' and 'I Ask', as a way into conversation with one's spirit guides.

courses.title: The Spirit Bridge: A Portal Between Realms
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen on building a working relationship with spirit guides. It covers grounded psychic development, a personal 'spirit language', past and future life journeys and small practice circles for feedback. Participants bring an oracle deck and a journal.

courses.title: Spirit Guide Session with Energetic Clearing
courses.description: A one-hour session on Zoom using her CCCE Method: contact with the client's guides, a conversation about recurring patterns, an energy clearing and agreed next steps. Bookings open three times a year to people on her mailing list.

courses.title: Seeker Program
courses.description: A season-long arrangement of three to six spirit guide sessions, paid monthly, with priority booking, contact with her between sessions and written notes and rituals after each meeting.

courses.title: 100 Days of Grace Workbook
courses.description: A digital workbook for a hundred days of daily reflection, with short meditations, mantras, prompts for action and messages she attributes to her guides. It is designed to build trust in one's own intuition over a full season.
